info.name: Property Report

request.description:
Report a property listing. One report per user per property.

Rate limit: 5 per hour.

reportTypeId: number, required. Get available types from GET /report-type.
description: string, required, max 1000 characters. HTML is sanitized.

On success, the property owner is notified asynchronously — via Telegram if they have a linked Telegram account, otherwise via email. The reporting user's identity is not disclosed to the owner. The admin also receives a Telegram alert (includes the reporter's name). This does not auto-unpublish the listing.

Errors:
- 400: Cannot report your own property
- 400: You have already reported this property
- 400: Validation error (missing reportTypeId)
- 404: Property not found
- 429: Rate limit exceeded

response.name: 201 Created
